name: sonarqube
description: Automatically enforce SonarQube code quality and security in the agent coding loop — 7,000+ rules, secrets scanning, agentic analysis, and quality gates across 40+ languages.

skills.name: sonar-analyze
skills.description: Analyze a file or code snippet for quality and security issues using SonarQube

skills.name: sonar-coverage
skills.description: Find files with low test coverage and inspect uncovered lines in a SonarQube project (project key optional when MCP integration already defines the default project)

skills.name: sonar-dependency-risks
skills.description: Search for software composition analysis (SCA) dependency risks in a SonarQube project (project key optional when MCP integration already defines the default project)

skills.name: sonar-duplication
skills.description: Find files with code duplications in a SonarQube project and inspect duplication blocks for a file (project key optional when MCP integration already defines the default project)

skills.name: sonar-fix-issue
skills.description: Fix a specific SonarQube issue in code by rule key and location

skills.name: sonar-integrate
skills.description: Installs sonarqube-cli if not already installed, authenticates, and integrates SonarQube with the current agent (installs analysis hooks & SonarQube MCP Server). Use when the user wants to set up SonarQube integration or asks to configure SonarQube.

skills.name: sonar-list-issues
skills.description: Search and filter SonarQube issues for a project, branch, or pull request via sonarqube-cli (`-p` is always required on the CLI; resolve the key from user arguments or sonar-project.properties)

skills.name: sonar-list-projects
skills.description: List SonarQube projects accessible to the current user

skills.name: sonar-quality-gate
skills.description: Show SonarQube quality gate status for a project — pass/fail and each condition (metric key, threshold, actual value). Project key optional when MCP integration already defines the default project.
